name: Proposal for a decision
title: REPORT on the request for the waiver of the immunity of Petr Bystron
part_text:
The European Parliament is lifting the legal protection that Petr Bystron, a member of the European Parliament, holds as an elected representative. German prosecutors in Munich want to charge him with fraud. They say that, while he was a member of the German parliament, he signed a job contract for an office assistant who did not actually do that job, and that public money (about EUR 14,850) was paid out as a result. Lifting his protection lets the German case go ahead.

- German prosecutors can now pursue fraud charges against Petr Bystron.
- It affects Bystron, who was not yet a member of the European Parliament when the alleged offence happened.
- The Parliament's President sends the decision to the German authorities and to Bystron.
